paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，因此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上评估，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 率，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最佳结果 [abstract]。作者还通过消融研究分析了 ACI 设计选择对 agent 行为和性能的影响 [S1.p4][S5.SS1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计适合 LM agent 的接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂数字任务上的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。作者指出，现有接口（如 Linux shell）是为人类用户设计的，LM agent 在使用时容易遇到困难，例如无法可靠地编辑小段文件、无效编辑时没有反馈 [S1.p2]。作者认为 LM agent 代表一类新的终端用户，具有自己的需求和能力，因此需要专门设计的 agent-computer interface [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
These deficits substantially hamper performance, motivating the need for an agent-computer interface (ACI)
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的系统，能够与计算机交互以解决软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。其 ACI 提供一组简单动作，用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并包含防止常见错误的 guardrails 和简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 的主要组件包括搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理，每一步 agent 生成一个 thought 和一个 command，然后接收执行反馈 [S3.p1]。设计原则包括：动作应简单易懂、紧凑高效，环境反馈应信息丰富但简洁，guardrails 可缓解错误传播 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
Actions should be simple and easy to understand for agents.
Environment feedback should be informative but concise.
Guardrails mitigate error propagation and hasten recovery.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite（300 个实例）上进行 [S4.p1]。此外还使用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本的代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。实验基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 成本 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2true294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric

findings.text: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在完整 SWE-bench 测试集上解决 12.47%（286/2294），在 Lite 上解决 18.00%（54/300），优于所有对比系统 [S5.p1]。相比 Shell-only，SWE-agent 的相对提升为 64% [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 率 [S5.p2]。消融实验表明，搜索接口、文件编辑器和 guardrails 等 ACI 设计对性能有显著影响 [S5.SS1.p3][S5.SS1.p4][S5.SS1.p5]。Agent 行为分析显示，成功运行通常较早提交且成本更低，大多数失败源于不正确的实现 [S5.SS2.p5][S5.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2true294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
An LM-friendly ACI’s value is confirmed by SWE-agent’s $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
This inefficient behavior can exhaust an agent’s cost budget or context window, leading to even worse performance than the not having additional search tools at all
Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).
successful runs complete earlier and at a cheaper cost than unsuccessful ones.
about half ( $52.0$ %) of unresolved instances fall into the Incorrect Implementation or Overly Specific Implementation categories
